# konnect_portal_form (Resource)

PortalForm Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "konnect_portal_form" "my_portalform" {
  api_registration = {
    fields = [
      {
        textarea = {
          description = "Please provide as much detail as possible. Supports MDC markdown."
          label       = "Message"
          name        = "full-name"
          placeholder = "Tell us what you need..."
          required    = true
        }
      }
    ]
    name   = "flights-api-registration"
    status = "unpublished"
  }
  developer_registration = {
    fields = [
      {
        submit = {
          name  = "submit"
          value = "Create account"
        }
      }
    ]
    name   = "developer-registration"
    status = "unpublished"
  }
  portal_id = "f32d905a-ed33-46a3-a093-d8f536af9a8a"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `portal_id` (String) The Portal identifier

### Optional

- `api_registration` (Attributes) A form shown to developers when they request access to a specific API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_registration))
- `developer_registration` (Attributes) The form shown in the portal's developer signup flow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--developer_registration))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity creation date.
- `id` (String) Contains a unique identifier used for this resource.
- `name` (String) A unique, URL-friendly identifier for the form (lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens). For `developer_registration` forms, this is always `developer-registration`. For `api_registration` forms, you choose the name when creating the form and can change it later.
- `status` (String) Whether the form is visible to developers on the portal. `unpublished` forms aren't shown to developers; for the `developer_registration` form, a default form is shown instead.
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity update date.

### Nested Schema for `api_registration`

Optional:

- `fields` (Attributes List) The form's fields, in display order. Must include exactly one `submit` field and a field named `api_id` of type `text`. Not Null (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_registration--fields))
- `name` (String) A unique name for the form that you choose (lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens). Not Null
- `status` (String) Whether the form is visible to developers on the portal. `unpublished` forms aren't shown to developers; for the `developer_registration` form, a default form is shown instead. possible known values include one of ["published", "unpublished"]; Default: "unpublished"

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = konnect_portal_form.my_konnect_portal_form
  id = jsonencode({
    id        = "5f9fd312-a987-4628-b4c5-bb4f4fddd5f7"
    portal_id = "f32d905a-ed33-46a3-a093-d8f536af9a8a"
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import konnect_portal_form.my_konnect_portal_form '{"id": "5f9fd312-a987-4628-b4c5-bb4f4fddd5f7", "portal_id": "f32d905a-ed33-46a3-a093-d8f536af9a8a"}'
```
